notes.title: Talisman: Digital Edition Now In Early Access
notes.notes:
Talisman: Digital Edition, the officially licensed multiplayer version of the classic fantasy adventure board game, Talisman, is now available in Steam Early Access.
 
This game is available as an Early Access release which includes local multiplayer for up to four human and/or AI players. The full version aims to include a full online multiplayer game for up to four players.

Purchasing during Early Access also gives you a copy of the single-player Talisman Prologue for free.
